$comment: HT-4001 mining haul truck twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the truck's specification sheet, the tyre maker's data and the haul road; the truck sends only what it measures.

identification.description: Rigid-frame mining haul truck, ore and waste haulage from the pit to the crusher and the dumps
identification.engine: Cat C175-16 four-stroke diesel, 16 cylinders in two banks, 85 L
identification.drivetrain: Torque converter and six-speed power shift transmission, differential 1.8:1, planetary final drives 16:1
identification.tyres: Six Michelin 50/80 R 57 XDR250 B E4R (2 front, 4 rear in duals)
identification.onboard: VIMS onboard monitoring with payload monitor; tyre pressure and temperature monitoring (TPMS)

engine.source: Cat 793F specification sheet AEHQ8089 (10-2017): gross power SAE J1995 at 1750 rpm, bore, stroke, displacement, torque rise. Net power (SAE J1349): Cat 793F product page. Idle speed and the 40 kW drawn at idle: assumption: typical value, replace with the engine's performance data (TMI)

fuel.source: Cat 793F specification sheet AEHQ8089 (10-2017): fuel of API gravity 35 at 16 C (density 141.5 / (131.5 + 35) = 0.849 kg/L) and LHV 42 780 kJ/kg; Tier 4 Final engine life target 3 785 411 L (1 000 000 gal) burned before replacement; tank 2839 L. Willans line fuel = zero-load fuel + marginal BSFC x engine power: assumption: typical value, replace with the engine's fuel map (TMI)

drivetrain.source: Cat 793F specification sheet AEHQ8089 (10-2017): gear top speeds and total reduction 28.8:1. Accessory power = gross 1976 kW minus net 1848 kW (fan, alternator, pumps). Engine-to-wheel efficiency 0.82 with the torque converter locked up: assumption: typical value, replace with Cat's rimpull data

truck.source: Cat 793F specification sheet AEHQ8089 (10-2017): operating chassis weight 124 586 kg (100 % fuel, 50/80 R57 tyres), body weight range 26 862 to 47 627 kg, nominal payload 226.8 t, target gross machine weight 390 089 kg, weight distributions. Body weight 38 703 kg: assumption, chosen inside the published range so that empty + nominal payload = target gross machine weight

payload_policy.source: Cat Mining Truck 10/10/20 overload policy, referenced on the spec sheet: the mean payload must not exceed the target, no more than 10 % of loads may exceed 110 % of target, no load may exceed 120 % of target

haul_road.source: Cat 793F specification sheet AEHQ8089 (10-2017) rule: 1 % of grade per 10 kg/t of rolling resistance. 3 % rolling resistance, 10 % ramp and the site speed limits: assumption: typical value, replace with the mine's haul road survey and traffic rules

tyres.source: Michelin Earthmover technical data 2022-23, 50/80 R 57 XDR250 B E4R: TKPH 1286; load 67 000 kg per tyre at 6.5 bar (the cold inflation pressure used here); K1 table for cycle lengths over 5 km; K2 for ambient temperature against the 38 C reference. Tyre gas temperature alarm 85 C: assumption: typical value, replace with the tyre maker's TPMS settings

engine_model.source: Expected coolant (thermostat-regulated, then ambient + rise in proportion to engine power), boost, exhaust port temperature and crankcase pressure against engine power: assumption: typical value, replace with the truck's own baseline from its first 500 h

oil.source: Engine oil wear-metal and silicon limits (ICP spectrometry) and the hydraulic oil cleanliness target (ISO 4406): assumption: typical value, replace with your oil laboratory's limits for the C175 and Cat's contamination control targets

demo.note: Demo only: one haul cycle (load, haul, ramp, dump, return) runs in 120 s of real time; the plant clock runs 15 times faster. Shift statistics, oil results and the lifetime counters come from the failure modes, not from the demo clock.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

payload_overload.name: Overloading at the shovel
payload_overload.symptoms: loads above 110 % of target, shift mean above target, tyres and frame carry more

air_intake_restriction.name: Air filter plugged (intake restriction)
air_intake_restriction.symptoms: boost low, exhaust hot on both banks, more fuel for the same work

injector_fault.name: Injector fault, right bank
injector_fault.symptoms: one bank hotter than the other under load

cooling_degraded.name: Radiator core plugged with dust
cooling_degraded.symptoms: coolant hotter than expected for the power and ambient

dust_ingestion.name: Dust ingestion after the air filter
dust_ingestion.symptoms: silicon and iron in the oil, blow-by up

tyre_underinflation.name: Slow leak, tyre 3 (rear left outer)
tyre_underinflation.symptoms: cold-equivalent pressure low, tyre runs hot

tkph_exceeded.name: Haul cycle beyond the tyres' TKPH
tkph_exceeded.symptoms: longer, faster cycles on a hot day: site TKPH above the tyre rating
